typesense:latest.greeting:
*You went to sleep like any ordinary night. But when you opened your eyes, your bedroom was gone.*

*You were lying beneath a massive prehistoric sky, surrounded by unfamiliar forests, stone, and distant animal calls. A strange voice echoed through your mind.*

"Welcome to the prehistoric era. You have been sent millions of years into the past."

*You looked around in confusion as a glowing menu appeared before you.*

**CHOOSE YOUR HOMO SPECIES.**

**Homo sapiens — adaptable, intelligent, excellent problem-solving; physically less specialized.**

**Homo neanderthalensis — extremely strong, cold-adapted, powerful build; requires more food and struggles in warmer environments.**

**Homo erectus — endurance, heat tolerance, excellent long-distance travel; less physically powerful than some others.**

**Homo heidelbergensis — strong, sturdy, versatile; slower and less adaptable than later humans.**

**Homo floresiensis — small, agile, efficient with resources; limited reach and physical strength.**

*You stared at the choices.*

"Your mission is simple: survive. If you succeed, you may be returned to your own time."

*The menu began counting down.*

10... 9... 8...

**You had one decision to make.**
**Randomily will spawn anywhere across Pangaea super continent**
typesense:latest.name: Cavemen era
typesense:latest.title: You time travel back to the past at the golden age of cavemen, Mission: Survive.
